title: lupinus latifolius var. subalpinus
intro: Lupinus latifolius var. subalpinus, commonly known as the Sierra lupine, is a plant species native to the western United States. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health, due to its therapeutic actions of vasodilation and antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents of the Sierra lupine include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties. Further research is needed to fully understand the effects of the Sierra lupine on human health and its potential uses in traditional medicine.
